subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep the runtime legacy no-code missing-source invalidation path, or should legacy cleanup move to doctor or migration code?
rationale: The explicit code marker follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy branch intentionally changes upgraded persisted SQLite behavior for a broader no-pluginId/no-code diagnostic shape.

options.title: Keep Runtime Legacy Invalidation
options.body: Accept the bounded runtime rederive behavior once the contributor provides raw latest-head legacy-upgrade proof.

options.title: Require Doctor Migration
options.body: Remove the legacy runtime branch and handle pre-code stale rows in doctor or migration-owned repair code instead.

options.title: Accept Source Proof Only
options.body: Maintainers may waive the external proof gate and accept the tests plus source inspection as enough for the upgraded persisted-state path.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime Legacy Invalidation
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded runtime rederive behavior once the contributor provides raw latest-head legacy-upgrade proof.
